2.2.10 ReportMIMEType
The ReportMIMEType type specifies a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) value or expression
that MUST evaluate to one of the following string values:
image/bmp
image/jpeg
image/gif
image/png
image/x-png
The ReportMIMEType type can be referenced by the following elements.
Referenced by
BackgroundImage.MIMEType
CapImage.MIMEType
EmbeddedImage.MIMEType
FrameImage.MIMEType
GaugeImage.MIMEType
Image.MIMEType
MapMarkerImage.MIMEType
PointerImage.MIMEType
StateImage.MIMEType
TopImage.MIMEType
